description: Action plan to continue Warehouse reconstruction after initial archaeology phase.

completed_phases.description: Enumerated all 911 artifacts by path, extension, size, and hash.
Classified artifacts into spec, schema, code, notes, manifest, agent-prompt, template, history categories.
Scored 15 artifact families. Confirmed 3 duplicate/reflection families. Identified 5 P0 authority candidates (CLAUDE.md, 3 spec docs, CHANGELOG.md).
Traced reflection families. Identified chat-derived artifacts. Noted session-local documents at risk of loss.

pending_phases.description: Human operator blesses canonical documents and resolves open questions from WAREHOUSE_SPECIFICATION.md §15.

recovery_items.title: Implement Signal-Lang parser
recovery_items.description: Build a parser/validator for Signal-Lang (YAML-in-Markdown). Must validate signals against signal-schema.json and produce normalized JSON output.
outputs: A test suite covering all five signal types
recovery_items.estimated_effort: small — schema exists, just needs validator
recovery_items.authority_impact: Raises AF-010 and AF-011 scores significantly

recovery_items.title: Define and implement lineage tracking schema
recovery_items.description: Create a JSON Schema for lineage records (provenance.json). Add a script that generates lineage records for new memory artifacts. Promote .claude/plans/DECISIONS.md decisions to docs/.
recovery_items.authority_impact: Enables trust chain for all sanctuary-runtime artifacts

recovery_items.title: Implement authority scoring script
recovery_items.description: Build a script (Python preferred for JSON/regex parsing) that computes authority_score for a set of Markdown files using the formula in WAREHOUSE_SPECIFICATION.md §C.
inputs: WAREHOUSE_AUTHORITY_MAP.json (as training reference for qualitative scores)

recovery_items.title: Implement memory taxonomy enforcement
recovery_items.description: Complete the stub scripts: refresh-indexes.sh (build 50-maps/ INDEX.md from file scan), new-session.sh (create 30-sessions/ entry), summarize-session.sh (compress to 20-projects/). Add a lint rule checking tier naming conventions.
outputs: Working implementations of the three stub scripts

recovery_items.title: Promote Vagrant Mode design to docs/
recovery_items.description: Read .claude/plans/2026-02-14-vagrant-mode-design.md and create a formal docs/VAGRANT-MODE-SPEC.md. Record the decision to promote in DECISION_LOG.md.
recovery_items.authority_impact: Prevents loss of 621-line design document on branch deletion

recovery_items.title: Create watcher event JSON Schema
recovery_items.description: Extract watcher event Go structs from internal/watcher/ and produce a standalone watcher-event-schema.json for non-Go consumers.
recovery_items.authority_impact: Raises AF-009 score; enables non-Go integration

recovery_items.title: Create unified retention policy document
recovery_items.description: Synthesize retention rules from CHANGELOG.md, cmd/agent-deck/main.go, and POLICY.md into a single RETENTION-POLICY.md.
recovery_items.authority_impact: Fills gap G-08; provides L7 governance document

recovery_items.title: Test and validate VRAM telemetry stack
recovery_items.description: Add dry-run test for reviewer-vram-check.sh with a mock Prometheus response. Document the procedure to verify DCGM exporter connectivity.
recovery_items.authority_impact: Raises telemetry confidence from medium to high
